# Fixtures

Every file below was downloaded on Oct 20, 2026 (about 8:00 am ET) from the cloud build environment
used for the setup pull request, **not from a GitHub runner**, and its layout was printed before the
parser was written. Fields are mapped by the exact labels shown. Contact names and phone numbers in
source headers were removed.

## Downloaded files

| Source | Fixture | Layout as printed |
|---|---|---|
| H.4.1 release page | `h41_20261015.html`, `h41_20261008.html` (full pages) | `Release Date: October 15, 2026`. Each table follows a numbered title paragraph: Table 1 is `1. Factors Affecting Reserve Balances of Depository Institutions`, split over two HTML tables (the second titled `... (continued)`); Table 5 is `5. Consolidated Statement of Condition of All Federal Reserve Banks`. Table 1 header: `Averages of daily figures | Wednesday Oct 14, 2026`, `Week ended Oct 14, 2026 | Change from week ended`, `Oct 7, 2026 | Oct 15, 2025`. Rows are label + 4 numbers; footnote markers are `<span style="...vertical-align:super">2</span>` (not `<sup>`). Changes print `+ 4,725` / `- 7,519` with an ASCII hyphen; negative levels `-26,334`. Sub-rows: `Repurchase agreements` → `Foreign official`, `Others`; `Loans` → `Primary credit`, `Secondary credit`, `Seasonal credit`, ...; `Reverse repurchase agreements` → `Foreign official and international accounts`, `Others`. Table 5 row `Total assets | (0) | 6,755,639 | + 8,079 | + 159,185`, header `Eliminations from consolidation | Wednesday Oct 14, 2026 | Change since Wednesday Oct 7, 2026 | Wednesday Oct 15, 2025`. |
| H.4.1 dated releases | `h41_dated_reads_20260624_20261014.json` | The 17 releases `https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/YYYYMMDD/` for Jun 25 – Oct 15, 2026, parsed by `h41.parse_html` (the full pages are 700 KB each; two are kept above). This is the seed check for `WEEKS`: all 68 values and the Oct 14 `DATA.h41` rows equal the page. |

## Not reachable from the build environment

| Source | Why not verified | Sample |
|---|---|---|
| BEA API, table T20804 | No `BEA_API_KEY` here (the API answers `Invalid API UserId`). The line label `PCE excluding food and energy` is the one the Yield Regime Monitor's runner dry run read with a real key. | `bea_api_doc_sample_T20804.json`, copied from the Yield repo: documentation-based structure, **numbers invented** so that Aug 2026 = 3.0. The page's `Real fed funds rate` log row keeps its "not re-checked" marker until a run reads the API, so the core PCE seed check runs then. |
